platform: GitHub-hosted macos-26, each run starts an isolated Chrome process and disposable profile with a synthetic file document.
ci_experiment_diff: One branch-specific Actions workflow. All app, product CI and fixture files match the product source tree.

swift_testing.assertions: includes the 16-case unavailable-snapshot regression, rejection after a second unproved observation, unexpected focus/layout, changed identity/selection/page/content, and no uncertain replay.

prior_evidence.observation: The field matched after one write. A failed post-write AX snapshot followed by another change revoked ownership. The prior log did not identify the missing attribute.
Initial insert/append confirmed. Before the target-switch scenario, the caret witness required by a continuous binding failed. No new write was attempted.

prior_evidence.comparison: Original fixture 3/3, setup-before-bind 3/3. A short application-level AXFocusedUIElement timeout was seen after startup. The old post-write failure did not recur and this run alone does not attribute it to DevTools.
Real normal and single post-write interrupted-focus scenarios both passed. Independent system AX exposed the same foreground PID, focused window and focused editor. A changed editor was rejected.

limits: A native independent AX read can still be incomplete. A missing real witness remains unverified and never triggers replay. No user chat or private profile was opened. Coverage is the owned Chrome textarea and documented regression suite.
